S2 (the key, its tombstone, the retired-keys entry, the D3 semantic entry and the `/meta/types` wire field) landed in PR #22874 (`e23eccb164`); this PR records that landed decision in governed text and changes no semantics. Ruling followed: `6073921182` (Q1 A · Q2 A, maintainer 「同意」); shape: triage `6121122315` — the two normative lines edited in place, a header amendment note on each ADR, history lines untouched, no residue. The card stays open for cloud's two test helpers. Five files, 22 changed lines (+18 / −4): four governed paths and one changeset — Tier H, draft only; an authorized APPROVED review lands it. ### `docs/adr/0005-metadata-customization-overlay.md` — a note at the top, an `Amended by` entry

Added under the existing 「v5.0 update (2026)」 blockquote, in the same voice:

> **Protocol 18 update (2026-10-12, ADR-0131 C5, #22340):** The per-type overlay opt-in on `MetadataTypeRegistryEntry` is spelled `allowEnvironmentOverlay` from protocol 18 (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts#allowEnvironmentOverlay`). [ADR-0131](./0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md) D6 retired the per-organization overlay axis, so the key now names the one scope it governs — whether an environment may overlay an item of this type that a managed package ships. The old key `allowOrgOverride` stays on the registry entry schema only as a tombstone that refuses at parse with the new name in its prescription: no second key, no alias, no conversion. The lines below that name `allowOrgOverride` describe the field as it was spelled when they were written and are preserved verbatim.

Appended to the `**Amended by**:` status line: `, [ADR-0131](./0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md) C5 / D6 (the per-organization overlay axis is retired and the per-type opt-in is spelled `allowEnvironmentOverlay` from protocol 18 — the note at the top of this record)`.

The body lines that name `allowOrgOverride` are untouched — 12 matching lines at BASE (`:47`, `:68`, `:515`, `:518`, `:521`, `:537`, `:596`, `:704`, `:707`, `:718`, `:719`, `:728`; the dispatch counted 13), each now two lines lower.

The header block gains, after `**Builds on:**` and in the block's own `**Key:** value` style: `**Amended by:** [ADR-0131](./0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md) C5 / D6 (the per-organization overlay axis is retired and the type-level opt-in is spelled `allowEnvironmentOverlay` from protocol 18 — the note at the top of this record)`. Its nine body lines naming the old key (`:19`, `:31`, `:94`, `:119`, `:122`, `:190`, `:297`, `:525`, `:605` at BASE) are untouched, each now three lines lower.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:把「某类元数据能不能被环境覆盖」这个按类型的开关,在四份给 AI 和人读的治理文本里改成代码里现在的名字 `allowEnvironmentOverlay`(旧名 `allowOrgOverride`):AGENTS.md 第 7 条规则、对外发布的 `objectstack-ai` 技能里的一行,ADR-0005 与 ADR-0010 各在顶部加一段「协议 18 起改名」的说明并登记被 ADR-0131 修订;两份 ADR 正文里描述当年字段的历史叙述原样保留。另附一条 `@objectstack/skills` 的 patch changeset,因为那一行是随技能包发布的。

**为什么改**:改名本身(S2,PR #22874)已经合入,代码、类型和 `/meta/types` 返回都只认新名,旧名写出来会在解析时被拒绝并提示改名。但 AGENTS.md 和发布的技能还在教旧名 —— AI 照文档写出来的键会被运行时拒收,正是「文档与契约不一致」这类事故的源头。ADR 是决策档案,按 ADR-0005 自己已有的惯例(顶部的「v5.0 update」注)只加注、不改写历史。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:零运行时风险 —— 不改任何代码、schema 或行为,只改文字。本地门禁 53 项中 51 项通过,2 项需要整仓构建、留给 CI 测量。代价是 `@objectstack/skills` 下个版本多一条 patch 条目。回滚:revert 本 PR 即可,无数据、无迁移。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:这是 Tier H 治理面(AGENTS.md、skills/**、docs/adr/**),需要你或 `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` 中的授权账号在本 PR 上给一个 APPROVED review,之后由席位合入。确认两点即可:① 新名字 `allowEnvironmentOverlay` 与 S2 落地的一致;② ADR 顶部加注的写法(照 ADR-0005 的「v5.0 update」样式)你认可。
